title: Second Bananas
intro: [excited] Ladies and gentlemen, tonight the heroes are sitting in the audience! It's a whole board of sidekicks, henchmen and loyal best buds. [laughs] Every great hero needs a second banana.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A grand theatre stage with the spotlight pointing not at the centre but at a small side wing, where a tiny stool, a little top hat and a bunch of bananas wait in the warm light.

categories.title: Gargoyle Gang
categories.intro: Our film category is The Hunchback of Notre Dame! Bells, gargoyles and one very judgy judge.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. The bell tower of a gothic Paris cathedral at sunset, huge bronze bells, three stone gargoyle statues perched on the ledge overlooking the rooftops of the city.

clues.clue: Quasimodo lives high in the bell tower of this famous Paris cathedral.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Notre-Dame! It's right there in the title. [laughs] Hope you rang that buzzer like a bell.

clues.clue: Esmeralda's clever little pet, who head-butts Frollo's guards, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a goat! His name is Djali, and he has a mean head-butt. [chuckles] Never mess with a goat with a gymnast for an owner.

clues.clue: The bell tower's three gargoyle pals are Hugo, Victor and this wise, pigeon-shooing lady.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Laverne! Hugo and Victor are named after author Victor Hugo, who wrote the original novel. Laverne just had to deal with them.

clues.clue: Quasimodo's cruel guardian, the Minister of Justice, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Judge Claude Frollo! [whispers] His song Hellfire is so dark it's honestly amazing it's in a Disney movie.

clues.clue: Laverne's voice actress Mary Wickes died during production, so this former child movie star finished recording her lines.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Jane Withers! She was a big child star in the 1930s and stepped in to finish Laverne after Mary Wickes passed away in 1995.

categories.title: Villains' Little Helpers
categories.intro: Next, Villains' Little Helpers! Even bad guys need an assistant to fetch the coffee. [chuckles]

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A villain's dim throne room lit by green candles, a tiny footstool next to a giant throne, a feather duster, a raven perch and a stack of crumpled evil plans.

clues.clue: Captain Hook's round, rosy-cheeked first mate is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mr. Smee! [laughs] Captain Hook's assistant, barber, and emotional support pirate.

clues.clue: In The Emperor's New Groove, Yzma's lovable, spinach-puff-cooking henchman is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kronk! Pull the lever, Kronk! [laughs] WRONG LEVERRR! Best henchman ever, and an excellent cook.

clues.clue: Maleficent's loyal black raven, who searches for Aurora for 16 years, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Diablo! While the goons look for a baby for 16 years, Diablo actually does the job. [chuckles] Employee of the century.

clues.clue: In Robin Hood, Prince John's sneaky snake advisor, who keeps getting stuffed in a basket, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sir Hiss! [laughs] He hypnotises people, and somehow always ends up in a basket or a jar. Rough job.

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Madame Medusa's two pet alligators who guard Penny are named Brutus and this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nero! Brutus and Nero, named after Roman history's not-so-nice guys. [whispers] Medusa picked fitting names.

categories.title: Whose Stuff Is This?
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a sidekick's favourite things. Name the sidekick!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A lost-and-found shelf stacked with tiny objects: a little collar, a miniature cage, a trumpet, a stolen cookie and a scrap of fabric, lit by a desk lamp.

clues.clue: This sidekick can't resist a snack. Name him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Meeko! Pocahontas's raccoon pal will braid your hair or eat all your biscuits, depending on the day. [chuckles] Mostly biscuits.

clues.clue: This palace pet is fiercely protective of a princess. Name him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rajah! [laughs] Jasmine's tiger bit the seat right out of Prince Achmed's pants. Fantastic boyfriend screening.

clues.clue: This swamp sidekick dreams of playing with the big bands. Name him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Louis! The trumpet-playing alligator from The Princess and the Frog. [excited] He just wants to be human so he can jam on stage!

clues.clue: This pampered pet loves luxury on a voyage to the New World. Name him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Percy! Governor Ratcliffe's spoiled pug. [laughs] He starts out the villain's pet and ends up best friends with Meeko.

clues.clue: This tiny sidekick was supposed to bring good luck. Name him.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cri-Kee! Grandmother Fa's lucky cricket. [chuckles] Whether he's actually lucky is still up for debate.

categories.title: Sidekicks at the Parks
categories.intro: Parks time! Sometimes the sidekicks get the spotlight at the parks. [laughs] Finally!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A colourful theme park plaza with a small comedy club marquee light, a parrot perch, a fiesta papel picado canopy and a scout badge sash hung on a fence.

clues.clue: Mike Wazowski hosts this live, interactive comedy show in Magic Kingdom's Tomorrowland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monsters, Inc. Laugh Floor! The monsters collect your laughs to power the city. [laughs] Mine is mostly snorting.

clues.clue: On Gran Fiesta Tour in EPCOT's Mexico pavilion, José Carioca and Panchito search for this missing pal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Donald Duck! The Three Caballeros have a show to do and Donald is off sightseeing. [chuckles] Classic Donald.

clues.clue: Disney's Animal Kingdom's Wilderness Explorers badge program is inspired by this young scout from Up.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Russell! Carl's tag-along sidekick just needed his Assisting the Elderly badge. [excited] Now kids earn badges all over the park!

clues.clue: From 1998 to 2011, Iago and Zazu took over Magic Kingdom's Tiki Room in a version with this subtitle.
accept: the enchanted tiki room under new management
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Under New Management! [laughs] Iago heckled the birds for over a decade before the classic show came back in 2011.

clues.clue: In 2021 at Shanghai Disneyland, Duffy the Disney Bear got this pink fox friend, a curious detective.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is LinaBell! She debuted for Shanghai's fifth anniversary and fans line up for hours to meet her. [gasps] Hours!

categories.title: Who's the Boss?
categories.intro: Our fan category! I'll name the sidekick, you name the hero they work for. [chuckles] Every sidekick has a boss.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A row of tiny empty chairs around a big director chair on a film set, a clapperboard without writing, spotlights and a coffee cup.

clues.clue: This hero's best buddy is a crab named Sebastian.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ariel! [laughs] Sebastian was assigned as a babysitter and ended up a sidekick. Happens to the best of us.

clues.clue: This hero's best friend is a tiny pixie named Tinker Bell.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter Pan! Tink is loyal, sparkly... [whispers] and extremely jealous of Wendy.

clues.clue: This hero's helpers include two mice named Jaq and Gus.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! Jaq and Gus help sew her a dress. [chuckles] Small paws, big talent.

clues.clue: This hero rides a giant, adorable roly-poly creature named Tuk Tuk.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raya! Tuk Tuk started out pocket-sized and grew into a full-size ride. [laughs] Kids grow up so fast.

clues.clue: This hero's loyal black horse is named Khan.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mulan! Khan carries her into battle and to the Emperor's palace. [chuckles] Way more reliable than a dragon.
